label: OPS
blurb: Run a chore on the machine: restart, deploy, config, cleanup.

stages.label: STATE
stages.instructions: State exactly what will be executed and what it affects — commands, targets, blast radius, rollback. Execute nothing in this stage.

stages.label: EXECUTE
stages.instructions: Run exactly what was approved, nothing more. Capture the output of each command.

stages.label: CONFIRM
stages.instructions: Verify the world is in the intended state (service up, config live, files gone). Show the checks and their output.
